summary: RB6-01, RB6-02, and RB6-03 close at e317dcae on both providers. The Green scan splits every text at every unescaped quote, decodes the head, each segment, and the tail with a tolerant decoder, and splits each decoded layer again. All 33 probe constructions behave as design B requires, except one probe that hits a word-boundary limit of the api-key-prefix pattern. That limit also applies to raw text and is outside the malformed-string class (RB7-01, low, nonblocking). The worst-case cost probe stays below 0.6 s. The focused rows and the full file pass.

prior_findings_status.RB6-01: closed. The split loop runs to index == text.length and emits the tail as a segment (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:1183-1196). A lone trailing backslash stays literal (tolerantDecode, src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:1242-1246). T129 and T130 pass for both providers. Probes: unterminated token, trailing backslash, unterminated token after a stray quote, and unterminated tokens at layers 1 and 3 all yield api-key-prefix.
prior_findings_status.RB6-02: closed. tolerantDecode (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:1208-1263) resolves each valid escape and keeps each invalid escape, each lone backslash, and each raw control character as literal text. It never throws. JSON.parse no longer gates the scan. T131 and T132 pass for both providers, and T131 also covers the MiniMax envelope. Probes: raw LF, raw TAB, \q, \u00zz, a lone high surrogate, a high surrogate before an invalid low escape, the envelope with LF, and the envelope with \q all yield a finding.
prior_findings_status.RB6-03: closed. Every unescaped quote ends a segment, so the segments cover both quote parities. T133 passes for both providers. Probes: one stray quote, two stray quotes, a stray quote in the MiniMax envelope, a stray quote at layer 2, and a prose backslash before a quote all yield api-key-prefix.

nonblocking_findings: RB7-01 low, class: other: src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:927 starts the api-key-prefix rule with \b. A credential that directly follows a word character (for example `zz` + escaped `sk-...`) gives no api-key-prefix finding. The plain form `zzsk-...` in raw text gives no finding either, so this is a pattern limit from RB-04, not a decode gap. The env rules have no boundary and still find an env value in the same construction (probe: env:PROBE_ENV_SECRET_KEY). Fix hint: record a tech-debt candidate. Do not change task 12. A pattern change must balance false refusals of words such as `task-`.

Split rule: the escape flag toggles once per backslash. The split loop and tolerantDecode use the same alignment from each segment start. A \uXXXX escape has no quote, so no split point falls inside one escape. Each escape at layer 0 therefore lies in exactly one segment.

Next layers: a decoded segment that holds a quote goes onto the worklist, and the scan runs on it when it comes off the worklist. A decoded segment without a quote is scanned only. A changed decode is strictly shorter than its segment, so the worklist always ends. A text with no quote is one head segment and is decoded (probe: `no quote at all` yields a finding).

Rule builder: secretFindings (line 948) and decodedAnswerFindings (line 1165) both call credentialRules(env) at call time. redactSecrets still builds its own list from the same two sources. That path only redacts, as at bb4e11f.

Write order, MiniMax: secretFindings at line 3401 and decodedAnswerFindings at line 3409 run inside the paid callback. runPaidCall appends success only after the callback returns. The raw copy and the review are written at lines 3452-3453. Write order, Kimi: readRawAnswer at line 3722, secretFindings at line 3723, and decodedAnswerFindings at line 3732 run before parseModelReview at line 3739. The review write, the raw copy, and the success entry follow at lines 3770-3780. Task 12 did not change these lines.

No fail-closed and no waiver: the code refuses only on a finding. Safe malformed twins are accepted (T138: twin cases 245, twin findings 0; probes: a safe LF twin and a safe prose quote give no finding).

Probe method: tsx -e imports the real module src/storytime/book-pictures.ts and calls decodedAnswerFindings and secretFindings. No file was written. Result: 32 of 33 constructions matched the design B expectation. The one mismatch is RB7-01. A rerun with a space before the credential gave api-key-prefix, so the decoder handles the bad low surrogate.
Named residual risk confirmed as stated: a credential encoded twice inside one string token with no inner quote gives no finding. test-strategy.md:1169 and plan.md:818 list this case as out of class.

Cost probe, fold chain: L_k = quote + enc(L_k+1) + quote, where enc maps a backslash to \u005c and a quote to \u0022. The work-maximizing depth for 65,536 bytes is 66 levels, about 2.9 million scanned characters. The scan took 429 ms with the base rules and 550 ms with 1,200 env rules. An escaped credential in the deepest payload gave api-key-prefix, so the scan reaches the last level.

Cost probe, wide: 5,572 distinct string tokens that each hold one escape, so every segment is decoded and scanned. With 1,200 env rules the scan took 442 ms. T136 strings hold no backslash, so T136 does not exercise this per-segment scan. The probe covers it.

Cost probe, repeated layers: the split loop has no dedupe after task 12, but segments partition each layer, so repeated layers add no amplification. 65,528 bytes of identical next layers took 36 ms with 1,200 env rules. Private-key headers in every segment took 33 ms.

Cost labels in this audit: wide scan ms 339 (bound 60000), chain scan ms 277 (bound 20000). Green labels: wide 473, chain 351. The known deviations (9,543 strings, 14 levels, corpus mode, the Green route) are accepted as stated.
A2: no audited test changes a draft to a published state. Task 12 adds no publication or consent transition.

A6: measure/tracks.md at e317dcae lists the track as [~] with no security-resolved claim. The plan marks task 12 [x] at line 778. Review A owns the plan claim. This review B result does not block that claim.

The task adds no endpoint, authentication boundary, tenant scope, migration, or secret store. The tests build the synthetic credential at run time and remove the injected env names in a finally block.
